title: オブジェクト指向プログラミング
subtitle: Object Oriented Programming
educationalGoal: In this course, students will: (1) Learn the concepts and practices of object-oriented programming in Java. (2) Learn the basics of classes and how to use objects. (3) Gain a deep understanding of the above by creating and running Java programs and verifying their behavior.
advice: This is a course in object-oriented programming and the Java language. We will cover the following materials: - Overview of object-oriented programming and Java, Installation of development environment - Java basics - Class, encapsulation, constructor - Class library, string - Class inheritance, interface - Exception handling, input/output - Multithread - GUI, event processing
books: Textbooks: Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of the knowledge/skills of "Fundamentals of Programming" and "Programming." Basic C language skills are required. Basic PC operation skills are required.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the concept of object-oriented programming.
Be able to develop basic programs using Java.
Be able to learn Java independently by referring to textbooks and technical materials.
